sites.source: Clearwater County campground page ('There are 89 campsites (handicap available) nestled among towering pines each with a picnic table and fire pit.') + county park map legend (NO HOOKUP, ELECTRIC, ELECTRIC/WATER, GROUP SITES, SEASONAL SITES), read 2026-11-11

values.note: 2026 season May 8 to September 13; primitive camping stays open for the fall hunting season.

season.source: Clearwater County campground page ('The campground is open May 8th through September 13th, 2026, with primitive camping available for the fall hunting season.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Reservations are required, by phone (Discover, MasterCard, Visa).

booking.source: Clearwater County campground page ('We accept Discover, MasterCard and Visa. Reservations are required.'; 'Please call (218) 657-2275 to make reservations.'), read 2026-11-11

note: Clearwater County park on spring-fed Long Lake, 5 miles from Itasca State Park: loops under tall pines on 53 forested acres, with a sandy beach, boat launch, fish-cleaning house and a 1-mile walking trail. --Claude
summary: County page and park map read: 89 sites under pines (no-hookup, electric, electric/water; 3 seasonal, a group area); 2026 season May 8-Sep 13 (was approximate May 15-Sep 15), fall primitive camping; reservations required by phone. Count 91 -> 89. Rates not found (the campground's own site is Cloudflare-blocked). Pin OK; not waterfront kept.
flags: Fees: none stored and none read. The county page posts no rate; the campground's own site https://longlakepark.com/ returned a Cloudflare block ('Sorry, you have been blocked') - UNREAD, not routed around. No price gate for a local park; the rate needs a human read of longlakepark.com.

Hookups: the county map codes electric and electric/water sites, but no page read gives the amperage, so hookups.electric stays unset (stored water true kept). Stored max_rig_ft 35 and pull_through (derived from the old note) were not confirmed or contradicted by anything read.
Long-stay tests: only three seasonal sites (60, 61, 87) of ~89 on the county map; the rest are nightly sites with reservations required. Not long-stay in character. Pass.
Season: 05-15/09-15 (derived, approximate) -> 05-08/09-13 from the county's 2026 dates.

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. On imagery the loops are under continuous pine forest; the nearest sites on the east loop are ~70 m or more from Long Lake through trees, and the beach, boat launch and day-use area sit between the campground and the north shore.
Pin 47.28301,-95.31224 is on the main campground road between the loops: OK.
Phone 218-657-2275 confirmed (county page). Website: https://clearwatercountymn.gov/longlakecampground confirmed; https://longlakepark.com/ unread (Cloudflare block) - keep it pending a human check.
